min_cm.description: Lowest criticality C_m (inclusive) that gets this level.
min_cm.title: Min Cm

max_fit.description: Upper limit of the step in FIT (inclusive).
max_fit.title: Max Fit

requirement_groups.description: Severity score 1-10 per requirement group (the 'Type' of a requirement). Needed in both modes.
requirement_groups.title: Requirement Groups

status_factor.description: Factor per status, 'LOST' and 'DEGRADED'. Needed in both modes.
status_factor.title: Status Factor

default_group_score.description: Score of a requirement without group.
default_group_score.title: Default Group Score

spof_severity_threshold.description: Smallest S of a single point of failure.
spof_severity_threshold.title: Spof Severity Threshold

mission_time_h.description: Mission time t in hours. Needed for --mode fmeca.
mission_time_h.title: Mission Time H

occurrence_scale.description: Occurrence O from the mode rate lambda_m = rate_fit * mode_ratio, for --mode fmea. Ascending steps; a rate above the last step gets 10.
occurrence_scale.title: Occurrence Scale

severity_classes.description: Severity classes for --mode fmeca, from the most severe, by smallest S.
severity_classes.title: Severity Classes

probability_levels.description: Probability levels for --mode fmeca, from the most probable, by smallest C_m.
probability_levels.title: Probability Levels
